title: Java
summary: Object-oriented programming with the language behind most enterprise code: from your first program to collections, streams and threads.
outcomes: Install the JDK and write, compile and run Java programs
Use variables, operators, strings, decisions, loops, arrays and methods
Model real problems with classes, inheritance, interfaces and encapsulation
Handle errors with exceptions and organise data with collections and generics
Write modern Java with lambdas, streams, records and enums
Read and write files, use threads safely, and build and test projects with Maven and JUnit
